sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions say a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges in the covered cases, but they do not state any RBI monetary penalty for levying them.
The earlier foreclosure-charges circulars were superseded and are no longer in force.

missing.slot: RBI monetary penalty amount for levying prohibited foreclosure charges
missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 paragraphs 260, 261(1), 261(2)(ii), 261(5), 261(7), and 261(8), and the superseded foreclosure-charge circulars; no monetary penalty amount was stated.
